title: Progression model design note (XP/milestone, ledger, supported-vs-blocked)
description: Decide the durable progression model before implementation: XP-vs-milestone advancement modes and how each binds to a campaign/rules pack; the shape of the auditable progression-event ledger; which level-up effects are deterministically supported from pack data (HP, class level, proficiency bonus, features, spell slots/cantrips) vs which require explicit player choices; and the explicit-block policy for unsupported choices. Grounds all sibling issues.
acceptance_criteria: A short decision/ADR-style note records: advancement modes and binding, ledger schema, supported effect list, required-choice list, and the block policy for unsupported cases.
notes: PR #323 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/323) — docs/design/character-progression.md. Open for review; close on merge.
